{{Sequel Disambiguation}}
'''Slimes''' are normal {{2|Monsters|Enemies}} found in the {{2|Overgrowth}}. They come in four varieties: two Leaf Slimes and two Twig Slimes, each in a small (S) and medium (M) size. They appear together in the Slimes encounter and as companions in other Overgrowth encounters.
== Encounters ==
* Easy Slimes: 1 of each (S) Slime, and a Random (M) Slime.
* Hard Slimes: 1 of each Slime variety.
* {{M2|Flyconid}} and a Random (M) Slime.
* {{M2|Slithering Strangler}} and 1 of each (S) Slime.
* {{M2|Slithering Strangler}} and a Random (M) Slime.

=== Pattern ===
{{Intents Table/start|Leaf Slime (S)}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Tackle
|Intent = Attack1
|Effect = Deals (3;{{Asc2|9|4}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Goop
|Intent = StatusCard
|Effect = Shuffles 1 {{C2|Slimed}} into your discard pile.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Randomly picks {{Int2|Leaf Slime (S)|Tackle}} or {{Int2|Leaf Slime (S)|Goop}} each turn. Cannot use the same move twice in a row.

{{Clear}}

{{Enemy Infobox

=== Pattern ===
{{Intents Table/start|Twig Slime (M)}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Chomp
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (11;{{Asc2|9|12}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Sticky Shot
|Intent = StatusCard
|Effect = Shuffles 1 {{C2|Slimed}} into your discard pile.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Always starts with {{Int2|Twig Slime (M)|Sticky Shot}}. After that, each turn it randomly picks {{Int2|Twig Slime (M)|Chomp}} (67%) or {{Int2|Twig Slime (M)|Sticky Shot}} (33%). Cannot use {{Int2|Twig Slime (M)|Sticky Shot}} twice in a row.

{{Clear}}
